title: Customer code check
description: A one-time code to the customer's phone before they are put on a sale. A capture on customer select: when the cashier puts an existing customer on a sale, the shop's server sends the customer (their id, name, phone, email and customer group), the till's store, its POS Profile, the cashier's user, the till's language, the sale's id and a code-check id, and the service answers allow, refuse or challenge. One record of PP CCC Rule per customer group: Ask for a code or Never ask, and what to do when the customer has no mobile number. A group with no rule takes the rule of the nearest group above it, and a customer with no rule up the tree is never asked. When the rule asks, the service writes a PP CCC Code record holding a 6-digit code and the customer's mobile number; the shop's own Notification on that record texts the code through the shop's own SMS gateway, inside the same save. The till shows a code field; the code the customer reads out goes back to the service, which checks it against the record (ten minutes, used once) and clears it. Three wrong codes end the check, counted by the shop's server. The store's walk-in customer is never asked. The service reads the rules, the customer group tree and the code records, writes the code records, and never reads the customer record. The install makes the role PP CCC Integration; the shop gives it to the app's integration user, with read on Customer Group, and makes the Notification. The capture installs switched off. When the service is down the customer stays on the sale and the sale is flagged for review; a text the gateway does not send leaves the customer without a code. allowed_urls is the programme bench's address; a partner writes its own.

fields.label: Customer group
fields.description: One rule per group, named by it. A group below this one takes this rule until it has its own.

fields.label: Switched on
fields.description: Off: this group takes the rule of the nearest group above it that has one.

fields.label: A code
fields.options:
Ask for a code
Never ask
fields.description: Never ask: lets a group below one that asks off the code.

fields.label: Without a mobile number
fields.options:
Take them off the sale
Let them on
fields.description: A customer of this group whose record has no mobile number.

fields.label: Words the cashier reads
fields.description: Shown with the code field, such as: Ask the member for the code we texted. Blank: the app's words, with the last two digits of the number.

fields.label: Code check
fields.description: The till's own id for this code check.

fields.label: Mobile number
fields.description: The number on the customer's record when the code was made. The shop's Notification texts the code here.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: The code the Notification texts. Cleared once the customer gives it.
